messages:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up: HighTide wants to renew but procurement is asking NET60 and a split-pay: 70% PO NET60, 30% CC upfront. They want no price change and a 12->18mo term extension. Need vendor code and a brief services appendix. Any objections?
Ethan (AE): They're pushing longer term to get internal approvals. Pricing unchanged is fine from quote perspective. Treasury approval needed for NET60 exposure on 70% PO. Suggest we propose 60/40 split to reduce risk.
Marta (HighTide): Procurement mandates 70/30 (PO/CC) due to internal cashflow. They prefer PO referencing our master agreement. DocuSign is acceptable if PO references the signed docs.
Priya (Billing): NET60 on large PO needs Finance/Treasury approval. Required items: vendor code, remit address, Tax ID, and PO number format. For split-pay we'll need CC auth webhook and invoice flow. Example header we require on PO: `
VendorCode: RWINF-09
TaxID: 22-3344556
PO: HT-2026-045`
Procurement Bot: Reminder: "NET60 where >50% of value is on PO requires Treasury sign-off and a short SOW appendix."
Nina (CSM): @Treasury can you advise exposure threshold? Also looping Legal Ops for appendix/acceptance language and signature path.
Treasury: For accounts under $250k ARR we can approve NET60 if at least 40% is captured on CC. Otherwise need exec credit approval. Send revenue schedule and expected collection timeline.
Ethan (AE): HighTide ARR = $140k. If they move to 60/40 we'll be within Treasury auto-approve. I'll propose 60% PO / 40% CC and 18mo term pro-rated.
Legal Ops: We'll draft a one-page services appendix with deliverables and acceptance criteria. Signature options: (1) DocuSign for amendment + appendix, (2) PO referencing Master + countersigned PDF. If PO contains NET60 we need explicit Treasury email approval on thread before invoicing.
Marta (HighTide): I can try to convince procurement to do 60/40. They prefer PO first then CC capture, but we need CC captured at signature for your billing system.
Priya (Billing): Proposed flow if 60/40 accepted: (1) capture 40% CC at signature -> (2) accept PO for remaining 60% with NET60 -> (3) invoice and track. We'll need vendor code and PO draft.
Nina (CSM): Action items: (1) Ethan to propose 60/40 + 18mo proration to procurement (2) Marta to send PO draft + vendor code (3) Legal Ops to prepare appendix (4) Priya to prep invoice template & payment link (5) Treasury to hold on final approval until CC auth screenshot + revenue schedule.
Ethan (AE): Reached out to procurement, including Treasury in the thread. :crossed_fingers:
Marta (HighTide): VendorCode=HTD-V-300. PO draft incoming tomorrow morning.
Priya (Billing): Payment link and invoice template ready; will share when PO/approval confirmed.
Legal Ops: Appendix draft done, sending to Nina via DM for quick review.
Treasury: Noted. Waiting for CC auth screenshot and revenue schedule. If 40% is captured we'll approve NET60 for the PO.
Onboarding Eng: We'll prepare kickoff plan but will not schedule live training until CC clears. Can start docs/training prep earlier.
Nina (CSM): Thanks everyone. Please react with :thumbsup: once your items complete. I'll update thread when PO or DocuSign arrives.
